company.note_on_legal_form: SBI is a statutory corporation constituted under the State Bank of India Act, 1955 (majority Government of India owned) — it has no 'Ltd'/'Limited' suffix, unlike a Companies Act entity.

exchange_listings.note: Face value ₹1 per share since the 10:1 stock split effective 20-Nov-2014 (split from ₹10 face value).

as_of.note: 2026-07-10 intraday/closing data was not yet available from any source queried at research time; all price-based figures below are the 09-Jul-2026 close unless stated otherwise.

sources: aggregated NSE/BSE quote via web search snapshot of dhan.co, kotakneo.com, businesstoday.in (https://dhan.co/stocks/state-bank-of-india-ltd-share-price/)
close_price_inr.cross_check: Two independent source lines (screener.in and NSE/BSE-sourced aggregators) agree to within ~0.5, consistent with normal NSE/BSE last-traded-price spread. No material disagreement.

market_cap_inr_cr.disagreement_note: screener.in reports ₹9,42,396 Cr vs ₹9,38,661.50 Cr from a Dhan-sourced aggregator snapshot for the same date — a ~0.4% gap. Likely explained by different intraday timestamps and/or slightly different outstanding-share-count snapshots (SBI raised fresh equity capital during FY26 per its board's ₹25,000 Cr QIP authorization, which can cause share-count lag between data vendors). Not resolved to a single number — both reported as-is.

pe_ttm.source: screener.in standalone page (default /company/SBIN/) and consolidated page (/company/SBIN/consolidated/)
pe_ttm.note: Bank quarterly results in India are reported standalone by regulatory requirement; consolidated (with SBI Life, SBI Cards, SBI MF etc.) is only reported half-yearly/annually — hence standalone is the more frequently updated, MRQ-consistent basis.

eps_ttm_inr.standalone_computed_basis: Sum of last 4 standalone quarterly EPS per screener.in: Jun-2025 21.47 + Sep-2025 21.84 + Dec-2025 22.78 + Mar-2026 21.32 = 87.41

book_value_inr.note: Standalone vs consolidated book value differ because consolidated includes subsidiaries (SBI Life, SBI Cards, SBI Mutual Fund, SBI General Insurance, etc.).

roe_latest_fy.company_reported_fy26: 18.57% (per SBI FY26 results commentary / press coverage of Q4FY26 results, alongside ROA 1.12%)
roe_latest_fy.disagreement_note: Three different ROE figures found across sources for what should be the same latest-FY period (16.2% standalone screener, 15.4% consolidated screener, 18.57% per company press release / financial media coverage of the FY26 results call). Not reconciled — likely differing denominators (average vs period-end net worth, or annualized-quarterly vs full-year net profit basis). Reported as-is with source attribution rather than picking one.

promoter_holding_pct.holder: President of India / Government of India

week52.dates_of_high_low: Not disclosed by any source consulted (only the price levels were shown, not the specific trading dates on which they occurred).
week52.price_change_52w_source: dhan.co aggregator snapshot, as of 09-Jul-2026 ('increased by 30.29% over the last year')

trailing_12_months_paid.source: screener.in / financial media (tipranks.com, investywise.com Q4FY26 coverage)

excluded_as_outside_ttm_window.reason_excluded: Paid ~14 months before the as-of date (09-Jul-2026), i.e. outside the trailing-12-month window (Jul-2025 to Jul-2026).

dividends.declared_but_unpaid_as_of_date: None found. SBI pays dividends annually (single payout in May/June following the March year-end); the FY2025-26 final dividend has already been paid (04-Jun-2026), and no FY2026-27 interim/declaration exists yet since Q1FY27 results are not due until ~Aug-2026.
dividends.cadence_note: Multiple sources confirm SBI is an annual (not quarterly/interim) dividend payer historically.

dividend_yield_pct.cross_check: Recomputed as 17.35 / 1022.10 = 1.698% ≈ 1.70% — matches screener's reported figure exactly.

quarterly_results_standalone.basis: Standalone (screener.in 'Sales' = total revenue/income line; consistent series used for MRQ growth calcs)

latest_quarter.label: Q4 FY26 (Mar-2026)
latest_quarter.source: screener.in; corroborated by groww.in, business-standard.com, univest.in, SBI's own Q4FY26 press release PDF (sbi.bank.in)

same_quarter_prior_year.label: Q4 FY25 (Mar-2025)
same_quarter_prior_year.source: screener.in; corroborated by businesstoday.in, zeebiz.com Q4FY25 coverage

quarterly_results_standalone.earnings_growth_calc: (19684 - 18643) / 18643 = 5.58% — matches media-reported 'net profit rises 5.6% YoY' for Q4FY26 exactly.

full_year_fy26_vs_fy25_cross_check.fy26_calc_from_quarters: 19160 (Jun25) + 20160 (Sep25) + 21028 (Dec25) + 19684 (Mar26) = 80032 — matches media-reported FY26 net profit exactly.
full_year_fy26_vs_fy25_cross_check.note: This full-year cross-check (independently recomputing FY26/FY25 totals from the quarterly series and matching media-reported annual figures almost to the crore) gives high confidence in the standalone quarterly series used above.

notes: Consolidated Q4FY26 figures (screener.in /consolidated/ page) showed revenue ₹1,31,080 Cr and net profit ₹20,508 Cr with a YoY profit decline of -71% vs a mislabeled 'Mar 2024' comparator of ₹69,543 Cr — this consolidated comparator almost certainly reflects a one-off gain in the Mar-2025 consolidated quarter (e.g., stake-sale/treasury gain at a subsidiary) rather than a genuine like-for-like decline, and the date label returned by the fetch tool was unreliable. The STANDALONE quarterly series (used throughout this pack for MRQ growth figures) is internally consistent and cross-validates exactly against independently reported FY26/FY25 annual totals and against multiple financial media outlets, so it was preferred as the higher-confidence basis. The consolidated series is reported above only for book value, P/E, and EPS (FY) where explicitly labelled 'consolidated'.

Primary source used: screener.in (both standalone default page and /consolidated/ page). NSE (nseindia.com) and BSE were targeted directly but NSE's site is not reliably fetchable by automated tools in this session; price/mcap were instead cross-checked via a web-search snapshot aggregating dhan.co, kotakneo.com, businesstoday.in and others, which independently corroborate screener.in's price to within ~0.5 and market cap to within ~0.4%.

moneycontrol.com could not be fetched in this research session (tool returned 'unable to fetch from www.moneycontrol.com'); moneycontrol was NOT used as a source for any figure in this pack despite being requested as a candidate source.
All figures should be treated as approximate for anything timestamped 2026-07-09; no confirmed 2026-07-10 closing data was available from any source at research time.
